links.outcome: Sensitivity for schizophrenia and misclassification of bipolar and depression patients on independent outpatient data
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.75 for schizophrenia; misclassification rates 59% for bipolar disorder and 55% for major depression, indicating poor specificity in the external sample.
links.quote: The misclassification rates were 59% and 55% for bipolar disorder and major depression patients, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Including multiple types of psychiatric disorders (e.g., bipolar disorder, major depression) during model development to improve specificity

screen.reason: The study conducts an external validation of an existing machine learning model (SZ classifier) on independent outpatient data, examining its transportability and misclassification rates across psychiatric conditions, but does not test a specific operational deployment practice.
